data.name: Alrah
data.gender_notes: Alrah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Exalted in rank and majesty, one who is worthy of the highest admiration and respect. The name Alrah carries the meaning “The Sublime One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alrah usually hope their child will grow to embody the sublime one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Ar-Rahman', which signifies the Most Gracious and Merciful One in Islam.
data.etymology: Alrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Sublime One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alrah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الرح
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرح هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، مشتق من الرحمة، يعني الذي يرحم عباده ويرحمهم، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'ولقد كتبنا في الزبور من بعد الذكر أن الأرض يرثها عبادي الصالحون'، والرح هو من الأسماء التي تدل على الرحمة والتعاطف مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: الرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: الرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو اللہ کے صفات میں سے رحمت سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے رحمت کرنے والا، مہربان۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کی تاریخی اہمیت ہے اور یہ اکثر ان لوگوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو رحمت اور شفقت کے حامل ہوتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अलरह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलरह एक इस्लामी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दयालु और दया का सागर। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसकी पृष्ठभूमि में इस्लामी परंपरा और संस्कृति का महत्व है। यह नाम उन लोगों को दिया जाता है जो दयालु और सहानुभूतिपूर्ण स्वभाव के होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: الرح
in_pashto.long_meaning: الرح د الله تعالیٰ یو نوم دی چی د رحمې څخه مشتق شوی دی، معنی یې هغه څوک دی چی خپلو بندګانو ته رحم کوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو تر منځ مشهور دی او په دینی او فر هنگی لحاظ کې یې ځانګړی اهمیت دی.

in_english.name: Alrah
in_english.long_meaning: Alrah is derived from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', signifying mercy and compassion. Referenced in the Quran as one of the attributes of Allah, Alrah embodies the qualities of being merciful and benevolent. Historically significant in Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes empathy and kindness. It is often bestowed upon individuals believed to possess a compassionate personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Alrah" signifies a person of great honor, dignity, and nobility in Islamic culture. It is a name that conveys a sense of respect, admiration, and reverence towards an individual. Using the name acknowledges their lofty position in society and their significant achievements, accomplishments, or qualities. This is a source of motivation and inspiration for others, encouraging them to strive for excellence and nobility in their own lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name "Alrah" can be interpreted as a reference to Allah, the one and only God in Islam. It signifies Allah's greatness, majesty, and ultimate control and power. The name is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards God and the importance of living a life that is worthy of His admiration and respect. It inspires a sense of humility and reverence towards Allah, encouraging individuals to seek His guidance and embrace the divine values of compassion, mercy, and justice. Ultimately, the name "Alrah" is a reminder of the ultimate goal of the Islamic faith, which is to seek Allah's pleasure and strive for a meaningful and virtuous existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Sublime One" symbolizes Exalted in rank and majesty, one who is worthy of the highest admiration and respect.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Alrah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the sublime one.

historical_references.reference: Al-Rahman and Al-Rahim are two names of Allah in the Quran, which mean The Compassionate and The Merciful respectively.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Alrah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
